ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) across >90% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to sparse circular clusters and a small contiguous patch on the right distal edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark field across both lobes. Scattered high-contrast white focal spots (mottling/barnacles) are distributed across the mid-to-lower sections. A distinct, high-intensity white patch is visible on the upper-right distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an approximate 65-degree internal angle and a vertical depth roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration along the entire boundary; irregular peaks and valleys with medium pixel-amplitude are concentrated at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to an upward and outward sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread distribution of small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across the ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent diagonal white linear mark on the upper inner quadrant of the right lobe; sparse, faint vertical striations on the inner left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense calcified barnacle clusters at both distal tips, significantly disrupting the smooth 2D geometric boundary of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Single, localized high-intensity red/orange pixel cluster located centrally at the base of the fluke near the peduncle interface.
